claim: Test transfer of the negative singleton PMP22 mechanical response, separately from genetic pathway relevance and regulator-RNA discordance.
context: GSE98547 human HEK293A WT 40kPa versus1kPa fibronectin matrix (3 culture replicates/arm), with separate RAP2/LATS/YAP-TAZ genotype arms; GSE292211 HEI-286 Schwann cell line compressed to5um for4h versus uncompressed (3 biological-replicate-labelled cultures/arm), plus5min compression followed by235min recovery; GSE79115 P3 P0-Cre Taz cKO;Yap cHet mixed nerve pools (deposit DBL-cKO labels retained) and GSE94990 P5 Dhh-Cre Tazfl/fl;Yapfl/+ and doublefl/fl mutants versus their specific TazYap controls.
baseline_model: Mechanical perturbations can regulate YAP/TAZ activity while PMP22 follows either a context-dependent state response or a broader myelin program. Regulator RNA need not track protein/activity. No universal mechanotransduction sign is assumed established.

prior_exposure: Inherited singleton target/comparator values and TEAD/PMP22 literature already known. Read GSE79115 source prose reporting Pmp22/Mag/Mbp and Egr2 down before this lock, so its directional genetic result is retrospective reproduction. Have not inspected numeric new outcomes for any of these four datasets. Metadata for GSE94990 shows swapped Gnas filenames and combined-method boilerplate; exclude those Gnas arms from this lock. No claim of model-wide absence of prior literature knowledge. Independent environmental predictions are prospective relative to this session's new outcome inspection; genetic quantitative comparison is a transparent locked reanalysis, not blind biological discovery.
prediction: stiffness-negative-transfer: WT40kPa-1kPa log2 PMP22 response is negative (point <=-0.15), transferring the sign of original stiff-soft observation across cell/species/matrix context. compression-negative-transfer: sustained4h compression lowers PMP22 by >=0.25log2 versus uncompressed;5min+recovery is separately descriptive, not a5min RNA harvest. yaptaz-rna-discordance: Pmp22 declines >=0.5log2 and its decline exceeds each Egr2 and Sox10 RNA decline by >=0.5log2 in GSE79115 and independently in GSE94990 partial TazKO/YapHet. DoubleKO GSE94990 is additional dose/context support, not independent of its shared controls. Relative myelin7 endpoint is descriptive and can reject apparent gene selectivity.
analysis_plan: Keep experiments separate. Full count matrices: exclude only HTSeq technical counters, require finite nonnegative integer counts, primary median-ratio size normalization over genes positive in all study libraries, sensitivity CPM and positive-count median ratio if needed. FPKM: use source values/status, no count likelihood or renormalization. Primary log response mean(log2(normalized abundance+0.5)) difference; additionally log2 ratio of arithmetic means and pseudocount0.1/1. Baseline eligibility: target/comparators mean control>=1CPM (counts) or>=1FPKM, and measured in all required source libraries, status OK for FPKM where supplied. Missing/failed status makes each required comparison untestable, not zero. Contrasts are unpaired unless primary identity proves pairing. Report individual samples, Welch intervals conditional on independent culture/pool labels, exact permutation conditional on exchangeability, leave-one-library direction, and warnings about unknown donors/pools; n2 arms descriptive only. All whole-universe effects retained and panel coverage explicit. No inferred fractions or causal state adjustment.
success_rule: Environmental magnitude criterion plus upper95% Welch interval<0 and every leave-one-library effect<0, with baseline eligibility and consistent sign under CPM/FPKM/low-signal sensitivities. Genetic joint quantitative criterion must hold in both declared partial-loss contexts with per-library sensitivity retaining direction; uncertainty reported, not a molecular-causality test. HEK dependence assessed separately: input-by-YAPTAZ interaction and baseline-floor diagnostics, no automatic necessity if knockout saturates/floors.
failure_rule: Eligible point estimate opposite direction or not meeting prespecified magnitude fails the quantitative prediction; interval crossing0 with otherwise correct magnitude is inconclusive for reproducibility, not no effect. Missing/floor/failed-estimate required genes make that specific test untestable. A sign that requires changing controls, excluding libraries or changing comparator panel after inspection cannot rescue the lock. If any eligible context fails the genetic conjunction, the universal declared RNA-discordance transfer fails.

selection_and_multiplicity: Three prespecified claims, report all outcomes and Holm correction across the three environmental WT/4h/recovery PMP22 contrast p-values as a secondary summary. Genetic comparison family Pmp22,Egr2,Sox10,myelin7,Itga6,Dag1 is interpreted descriptively at small n; whole-universe p-values not used for target selection. BH only if an exploratory whole-universe screen is later performed, explicitly labelled. Do not select new validation from favorable observed outcomes.
alias_policy: Species-native gene symbols preserved; prespecified conventional CCN2/CTGF and CCN1/CYR61 aliases only with annotation support. No ortholog numerical pooling or coordinate transfer. Ambiguous mapping retained and excluded from required unique-gene tests pending source annotation.
